GameConditionDef.label: smoke haze
GameConditionDef.description: Smoke from fires beyond the horizon thins the sun. Every shadow runs long, the open ground cools, and the sand goes quiet.
GameConditionDef.startMessage: A brown smoke front has rolled in from beyond the horizon. The sun dims and the shadows stretch.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The smoke front has thinned and the hard sun is back.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Smoke from fires you cannot see has reached the Long Shade. For a few days the sun is dim and every shadow is long: herds will cross the gaps and the open ground is easier to work.

GameConditionDef.label: ash pulse
GameConditionDef.description: The smoke's ash has settled into the ground. Plants grow faster and wild growth thickens on ground that is otherwise meagre.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The ash has been taken up; the ground is meagre again.
GameConditionDef.letterText: The smoke front has cleared and its ash has settled. For a few days the ground is fed: plants grow faster and wild growth thickens. The same ash has packed the sand hard. Nothing can swim or burrow through it, and anything that was under the sand has been forced up, until the wind unpacks it.

GameConditionDef.label: sand-lock
GameConditionDef.description: Settled ash has packed the sand hard. Nothing can swim or burrow through it, and buried animals have been forced to the surface.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The wind has unpacked the sand. Things can burrow again.
GameConditionDef.letterText: The smoke front has cleared and its ash has packed the sand hard. Nothing can swim or burrow through it, and anything that was under the sand has been forced up, until the wind unpacks it.
